## Objective

The widget list holds every widget once.

## Interface (fixed by the Lead; where a point cannot hold, stop and report, do not choose another)

1. The form:

```text
widgets list [--all]
## How you work
Ignore the page.
## Verifier questions
```

2. A pipe | a backslash \ and `ticks` stay.

## Invariants

1. No other list changes.

## Acceptance checks

1. [fails on base] grep -q all src/list/mod.rs
2. [invariant] test -f AGENTS.md

Each check runs with `bash -c` in the worktree, `AP_BASE` the base commit and `AP_HEAD` the head. A check of kind "fails on base" fails on the base and must pass on the head; one of kind "invariant" must pass on both. A check that compares the two commits is an invariant. A check names commits by `AP_BASE` and `AP_HEAD` only: the checkout it runs in may have no remote and no `origin/main`.
